audit.whatIsWrong: The level-2 and level-3 rows are shifted one step. whys[1] describes a free chunk before Bellows Breath and Brittle exist, which is a Gnar row, but win[1] says Skill; whys[2] explicitly says 'neither side fully owns it', which is a Skill row, but win[2] says Ornn.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Ornn, Gnar, Ornn, Ornn] and matches the prose on both rows and everywhere else.
audit.corrected: win[1] and win[2] plus the matching phases sides flipped as one group; level 2 rated 7/10, level 3 rated 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].why in the full layer was generic template text naming Stridebreaker and 'Volcanic Rupture's cooldown' rather than this lane's real timings, and no cooldown number appeared anywhere.
audit.why: The real timings are level 2 before Bellows Breath, levels 4-5 once Searing Charge is up (14s at rank 1), level 6 gated on Mega, and Ornn's item spikes — which he reaches without recalling because Living Forge lets him buy in the field.
audit.corrected: All seven rewritten to the content layer's story with Searing Charge's 14s cooldown stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] is titled 'Dodge his Q knockup'. Volcanic Rupture does not knock up — Riot's Q text is damage, a slow, and a magma pillar formed after a delay. The knockup is Searing Charge (E), and only when Ornn collides with terrain while charging.
audit.why: Misattributing the knockup to the wrong ability makes the dodge advice point at the wrong cast. Riot's E text: 'If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave... and knocks up enemies.'
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now states which ability actually knocks up and what triggers it. Note the .t title is 19 characters, under the applier's 25-character floor, so the wrong title needs a manual sweep.

audit.why: The existing content already gets the two hardest things right: that Ornn's E has a minimum travel distance or terrain requirement for the knockup, and that Brittle is a detonation applied by the final gout of Bellows Breath rather than a passive debuff. Both match Riot's text.

edits.before: Boomerang + hop kite wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Ornn contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Ornn has no dash and no ranged answer at 1 — your Mini autos and a single Boomerang win the first trade clean.

edits.before: Rage management is the champion — track your own bar. Only take the trade when Ornn's Volcanic Rupture is down.
edits.after: Your Hyper third-hit plus a caught Boomerang is a free chunk before Bellows Breath and Brittle exist.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ornn must walk into your range.
edits.after: A Rage-timing skill check: you kite his immobile body, but Searing Charge into Brittle deletes a misstep.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Volcanic Rupture's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: With Bellows Breath and a 14s Searing Charge online, any Mini window eats a pillar knockup into Brittle you cannot survive.

edits.before: Mega + R against a wall is the best engage top lane owns. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: With Mega loaded you Wallop-stun and GNAR! him into a wall for the bonus damage — your one guaranteed kill window.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Volcanic Rupture's cooldown.
edits.after: He forges items in base for free and out-tanks Boomerang chip faster than you re-stack Rage.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Ornn carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Free masterwork bulk and the Call of the Forge God double-knockup outscale your form-dependent burst window.

edits.before: Boomerang Ornn's last-hits, AA-hop out of his reach, and time Mega so the transform lands ON his engage window.
edits.after: Chip his low base MR at Boomerang range and catch the return — a caught boomerang cuts its own cooldown.

edits.before: Ornn wastes Volcanic Rupture — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture only slows; the knockup is Searing Charge into terrain.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Brittle lands off his final gout of flame — leave the cone early.

notes: packet.defects flags "Bellows Breath's" in wants.foe[1] as a probable wrong name — FALSE POSITIVE, the possessive apostrophe is the whole edit distance. Two things I deliberately did not write. First, wants.foe[1] credits Bellows Breath with damage reduction; the kit file's W text stops at Brittle and says nothing about it, so I neither asserted nor removed it. Second, Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar is terrain, and GNAR! stuns anything it slams into a wall — whether the pillar counts as a wall for that stun is not answerable from the kit text and I did not put it on the page.
